name: tuck up
description: Seated or reclined, you pull knees and chest together and then extend out again. It works the abs and hip flexors, especially the lower abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.
